entries.title: Isaiah 64:1
segments: Oh that You would tear the heavens [and] come down, [that] mountains would quake before You,

entries.title: Isaiah 64:2
segments: ([as] the brushwood fire burns, the fire causes water to boil), to make Your name known to Your foes, [that] the nations may tremble at Your presence!

entries.title: Isaiah 64:3
segments: When You did dreadful things [which] we did not look for, You came down, the mountains flowed down at Your presence.

entries.title: Isaiah 64:4
segments: And from forever they have not heard, nor did they listen. Eye has not seen a God except You, who works for him who waits for Him.

entries.title: Isaiah 64:5
segments: You meet him who rejoices and works righteousness, [those who] remember You in Your ways. Behold, You were angry, for we sinned. In them [is] eternity, and we will be saved.

entries.title: Isaiah 64:6
segments: But we are all as the unclean [thing], and all our righteousnesses [are] as a menstruous cloth. And we all fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.

entries.title: Isaiah 64:7
segments: And [there is] no one who calls on Your name, who stirs up himself to take hold of You. For You have hidden Your face from us, and have melted us away because of our iniquities.

entries.title: Isaiah 64:8
segments: But now, O LORD, You [are] our Father; we [are] the clay, and You [are] our Former; and we all [are] the work of Your hand.

entries.title: Isaiah 64:9
segments: Do not be grievously angry, O LORD, nor remember iniquity forever. Behold! Look, please; all of us [are] Your people.

entries.title: Isaiah 64:10
segments: Your holy cities are a wilderness; Zion [is] a wilderness, Jerusalem [is] a ruin.

entries.title: Isaiah 64:11
segments: The house of our holiness and our beauty, where our fathers praised You, has become a burning of fire; and all our pleasant things are laid waste.

entries.title: Isaiah 64:12
segments: Will You restrain Yourself over these [things], O LORD? Will You be silent and sorely afflict us?
